title: Fix the Audience Trap
brief: A gym in Pune is running ads, but their frequency has skyrocketed and people are complaining about ad fatigue. Fix the audience size from narrow (< 100k) to balanced or broad, select an engaging creative, and achieve frequency ≤ 3.0 with at least 20 new membership leads!
